mapper.select: { call GET_MAIN_RANKING(#{period, jdbcType=VARCHAR, mode=IN}, #{result, jdbcType=CURSOR, mode=OUT, resultMap=top10ResultMap}) }

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT k.KEYWORD_NAME as keyword_name, SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) as total_count, COUNT(DISTINCT kds.STATS_DATE) as mention_days FROM KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS kds JOIN KEYWORD k ON kds.KEYWORD_ID = k.KEYWORD_ID WHERE kds.STATS_DATE >= TO_DATE('2025-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND kds.STATS_DATE <= TO_DATE('2025-07-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND k.KEYWORD_NAME NOT IN ('간장', '게장', '가지', '궁채') AND k.KEYWORD_NAME NOT IN ( SELECT TOP10.KEYWORD_NAME FROM ( SELECT k2.KEYWORD_NAME FROM KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS kds2 JOIN KEYWORD k2 ON kds2.KEYWORD_ID = k2.KEYWORD_ID WHERE kds2.STATS_DATE >= TO_DATE('2025-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND kds2.STATS_DATE <= TO_DATE('2025-07-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY kds2.KEYWORD_ID, k2.KEYWORD_NAME HAVING SUM(kds2.DAILY_COUNT) > 0 ORDER BY SUM(kds2.DAILY_COUNT) DESC ) TOP10 WHERE ROWNUM <= 10 ) GROUP BY kds.KEYWORD_ID, k.KEYWORD_NAME HAVING SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) > 0 ORDER BY SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) DESC, DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE() ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 3

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT k.KEYWORD_NAME as keyword_name, SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) as total_count, COUNT(DISTINCT kds.STATS_DATE) as mention_days FROM KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS kds JOIN KEYWORD k ON kds.KEYWORD_ID = k.KEYWORD_ID WHERE kds.STATS_DATE >= TO_DATE('2025-07-25', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND kds.STATS_DATE <= TO_DATE('2025-07-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND k.KEYWORD_NAME NOT IN ('간장', '게장', '가지', '궁채') AND k.KEYWORD_NAME NOT IN ( SELECT TOP10.KEYWORD_NAME FROM ( SELECT k2.KEYWORD_NAME FROM KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS kds2 JOIN KEYWORD k2 ON kds2.KEYWORD_ID = k2.KEYWORD_ID WHERE kds2.STATS_DATE >= TO_DATE('2025-07-25', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND kds2.STATS_DATE <= TO_DATE('2025-07-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY kds2.KEYWORD_ID, k2.KEYWORD_NAME HAVING SUM(kds2.DAILY_COUNT) > 0 ORDER BY SUM(kds2.DAILY_COUNT) DESC ) TOP10 WHERE ROWNUM <= 10 ) GROUP BY kds.KEYWORD_ID, k.KEYWORD_NAME HAVING SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) > 0 ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE() ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 3

SELECT NVL(kds.DAILY_COUNT, 0) as daily_count FROM ( SELECT TO_DATE('2025-07-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD') - LEVEL + 1 as stats_date FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= #{days} ) dates LEFT JOIN ( SELECT kds.STATS_DATE, kds.DAILY_COUNT FROM KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS kds JOIN KEYWORD k ON kds.KEYWORD_ID = k.KEYWORD_ID WHERE k.KEYWORD_NAME = #{keyword} AND kds.STATS_DATE >= TO_DATE('2025-07-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD') - #{days} + 1 AND kds.STATS_DATE <= TO_DATE('2025-07-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD') ) kds ON dates.stats_date = kds.STATS_DATE ORDER BY dates.stats_date ASC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT k.KEYWORD_NAME as keyword_name, SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) as total_count, COUNT(DISTINCT kds.STATS_DATE) as mention_days FROM KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS kds JOIN KEYWORD k ON kds.KEYWORD_ID = k.KEYWORD_ID WHERE kds.STATS_DATE >= TO_DATE('2025-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND kds.STATS_DATE <= TO_DATE('2025-07-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND k.KEYWORD_NAME NOT IN ('간장', '게장', '가지', '궁채') AND k.KEYWORD_NAME NOT IN ( SELECT TOP15.KEYWORD_NAME FROM ( SELECT k2.KEYWORD_NAME FROM KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS kds2 JOIN KEYWORD k2 ON kds2.KEYWORD_ID = k2.KEYWORD_ID WHERE kds2.STATS_DATE >= TO_DATE('2025-07-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND kds2.STATS_DATE <= TO_DATE('2025-07-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY kds2.KEYWORD_ID, k2.KEYWORD_NAME HAVING SUM(kds2.DAILY_COUNT) > 0 ORDER BY SUM(kds2.DAILY_COUNT) DESC ) TOP15 WHERE ROWNUM <= 15 ) GROUP BY kds.KEYWORD_ID, k.KEYWORD_NAME HAVING SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) > 0 ORDER BY SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) DESC, DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE() ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
